services.name: Day Use
services.desc: At Jellystone Park™, we have all kinds of ways to make your stay easier and more fun! Please Note: Prices are subject to change without notice and all rates are subject to Federal and Local taxes. Day-Use Pass is for guests that are visiting Yogi on the Lake for a single day. Whether you are from the local area or just visiting someone in a campsite or cabin this pass allows you to access the park facilities including the splash park, Pelahatchie Lake, mini golf course, planned activities, cafe, shopping and more.
